// Helper function to generate effect IDs
func generateEffectID(counter int64) string {

// executeSwitchPTEffect implements switch_pt (ticket engine.switch-pt/v1):
// swaps a creature's current power and toughness until end of turn without
// mutating its printed base P/T. Reuses ContinuousEffect's existing
// SetPower/SetToughness fields, so Register's default-layer logic slots it
// into Layer 7b exactly like any other "becomes X/Y" effect, and reads the
// LIVE pre-swap power/toughness (GetPowerWithEffects/GetToughnessWithEffects,
// which already fold in prior Layer 7b/7c effects) so it composes with
// whatever is already registered. UntilEOT ties expiry to the existing
// end-of-turn cleanup (EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT) — no new lifecycle.
// Supports self (no targets, mirrors executePumpEffect's self-pump shape),
// the printed target-creature form, and "each creature"
// (effectValue["target"] == "each", mirroring executePutCounterEffect's
// each-shape) — the three pre-proven scopes this primitive needs.
func (gs *GameState) executeSwitchPTEffect(controller int, source *Card, effectValue map[string]interface{}, targets []Target) error {
	applySwitchPT := func(card *Card) {
		if card == nil || !card.IsCreature() {
			return
		}
		power := card.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager)
		toughness := card.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager)
		gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{
			Source:          source,
			AffectsSpecific: card.ID,
			SetPower:        &toughness,
			SetToughness:    &power,
			UntilEOT:        true,
		})
	}

	if getStringValue(effectValue, "target", "") == "each" {
		for _, c := range gs.Battlefield.GetAll() {
			applySwitchPT(c)
		}
		return nil
	}

	if len(targets) == 0 {
		applySwitchPT(source)
		return nil
	}

	for _, target := range targets {
		if !target.IsCard {
			continue
		}
		card, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(target.CardID)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		applySwitchPT(card)
	}
	return nil
}

package game

import "testing"

// TestSwitchPT_TargetCreatureSwapsUntilEndOfTurn proves the switch_pt
// primitive (ticket engine.switch-pt/v1): a targeted 2/5 becomes 5/2, an
// unaffected creature is untouched, and end-of-turn cleanup restores 2/5.
func TestSwitchPT_TargetCreatureSwapsUntilEndOfTurn(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)

	target := NewCreature("Switch Pt Bear", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 1)
	target.Owner, target.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(target)

	unaffected := NewCreature("Switch Pt Squirrel", ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
	unaffected.Owner, unaffected.Controller = 1, 1
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(unaffected)

	targets := []Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: target.ID}}
	if err := gs.executeSwitchPTEffect(0, nil, map[string]interface{}{}, targets); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("executeSwitchPTEffect: %v", err)
	}

	if p, tg := target.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), target.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 5 || tg != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("target after switch_pt = %d/%d, want 5/2", p, tg)
	}
	if p, tg := unaffected.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), unaffected.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 2 || tg != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("unaffected creature changed: %d/%d, want 2/2", p, tg)
	}

	gs.EffectManager.RemoveUntilEOT()

	if p, tg := target.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), target.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 2 || tg != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("target after cleanup = %d/%d, want 2/5", p, tg)
	}
}
